name: SK Hynix
day_summary: SK Hynix broke to a new all-time high of ₩2,425,000 on the KOSPI session today — surpassing the prior ATH of ₩2,407,000 set June 2. The stock gained +4.2% from Tuesday's ₩2,327,000 close, delivering exactly the price discovery above the ATH that the June 16 brief flagged as the bull case outcome for a neutral Warsh FOMC. The breakout was catalyzed by the combination of: (1) Tuesday's SK Hynix disclosure on June 16 confirming it is reviewing shareholder value enhancement measures, (2) the NVIDIA multi-year partnership supply chain read-through, and (3) TradingKey research citing HBM shortage conditions persisting until 2028. The KOSPI session is complete; the new ATH is confirmed. The US macro (Warsh FOMC at 2:30 PM ET) is the only remaining near-term gate for whether the new ATH becomes the floor or faces a retest.
long_pnl: +4.2% on the session; three-week advance from ₩2,048,000 (June 12 low) now +18.4%; year-to-date advance ~+272%; longs from any prior entry are deep in the money on the ATH break
short_pnl: a nightmare session — shorts facing a new ATH with the squeeze dynamics of a thin float, NVIDIA read-through, and shareholder value enhancement catalyst all arriving simultaneously; the short-side case has no near-term catalyst

decision.rationale: BUY at HIGH conviction — the ATH break is the confirmation. The June 16 brief established ₩2,407,000 as the level that needed to break to confirm price discovery; it has broken cleanly to ₩2,425,000. All three structural pillars are intact: ~70% HBM market share with NVIDIA locked through 2030, ~20% HBM3E price hikes for 2026, and a record Q1 (₩52.6T revenue, 72% operating margin). The shareholder value enhancement disclosure adds a new catalyst layer — any buyback/dividend announcement re-rates the stock. Sizing guidance: hold the core long, drift stops up to ₩2,280,000–₩2,300,000. The post-FOMC scenario: a neutral Warsh extends the ATH run toward the ₩2,520,000 analyst consensus PT; a hawkish surprise provides the add window at ₩2,350,000–₩2,380,000.

positioning.short_interest: Foreign-owned ~54% of float — net foreign buying extended to a fifth consecutive session on the ATH break; the KRW is under mild pressure with USD/KRW estimated at ~₩1,512 given DXY at 99.57 (June 16 close); DXY only 0.43 pts from the 100 trigger means a hawkish Warsh dot tonight could reverse the won's post-Iran deal appreciation and compress dollar-denominated returns for the foreign float
positioning.notable_flow: Volume of ~5.3M shares on the ATH breakout is above the two-day average (~4.1M shares), confirming this is a conviction-backed breakout rather than a thin-tape squeeze. Foreign flows remain net-buying for the fifth consecutive session. The shareholder value enhancement disclosure from June 16 is drawing incremental value-style buyers who read any buyback/dividend program as a multiple-expansion event on top of the growth story. The ~38-analyst PT near ₩2.52M is only 3.9% above the new ATH — a PT revision wave from sell-side analysts who haven't updated since the NVIDIA partnership and the bond-sale demand signal is likely; fresh PT upgrades to ₩2.7M–₩3.0M would be the next incremental bid.

what_traders_are_doing: Riding the breakout. The playbook after a clean ATH break on above-average volume: hold the core, drift stops up, do not chase extensions on the first day above the ATH, and watch for a post-FOMC consolidation as the next add opportunity. The Friday June 20 expiry (US monthly options) and Juneteenth (US holiday June 19) mean the US session into weekend is thin — but SK Hynix doesn't trade on US holidays. Desks are holding their KOSPI longs, raising stops to ₩2,280,000–₩2,300,000, and waiting for the Warsh presser tonight (Korean time) to determine if the ATH break holds as the new floor or needs a retest.

analysis:
## New all-time high confirmed — the breakout the brief was waiting for

SK Hynix printed **₩2,425,000** on the June 17 KOSPI session — a new all-time high, breaking cleanly above the **₩2,407,000** ATH set June 2 that represented four weeks of resistance. The June 16 brief stated exactly: 'A non-hawkish Fed on June 17 — hold, neutral stance language, no hike signal — takes the stock into price discovery above the ATH.' The market delivered the price discovery before Warsh even opened his mouth, which is the strongest possible signal: this breakout is not FOMC-anticipation; it is fundamental-demand driven.

## What drove the break

Three catalysts converged: (1) [SK Hynix's June 16 disclosure](https://ca.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/why-did-sk-hynix-surge-to-a-record-high-93CH-4695027) confirming review of 'shareholder value enhancement measures' — a buyback/dividend signal that attracted value buyers who had been waiting for yield; (2) [TradingKey research](https://www.tradingkey.com/analysis/stocks/more/261879241-sk-hynix-hbm-shortage-samsung-tracker-valuation-tradingkey) citing HBM shortage conditions persisting until 2028, extending the pricing power thesis by two full years beyond the consensus; (3) the NVIDIA supply chain read-through from the $25B bond sale ($85B orders) — funded AI capex demand flows directly to the primary HBM supplier.

## The ATH as the new floor

The prior ₩2,407,000 ATH is now structural support. Volume on the breakout session (~5.3M shares, above the recent ~4.1M average) confirms this is not a thin-tape squeeze. The [~38-analyst consensus PT near ₩2.52M](https://stockanalysis.com/quote/krx/000660/) is only 3.9% above today's new ATH — that PT was set before the HBM-shortage-until-2028 research, before the shareholder value enhancement disclosure, and before the NVIDIA bond sale. A PT revision wave from analysts who haven't updated since the partnership announcement is likely the next incremental demand catalyst. The next resistance level after ₩2.52M is open sky.
